title: RARE Vintage Kodak Winner Pocket Camera Film Camera 1988 Olympic Games
categoryName: Cameras & Photo:Vintage Movie & Photography:Vintage Cameras:Other Vintage Cameras
descriptionText: The product is a rare vintage Kodak Winner Pocket Camera from 1988, designed for the Olympic Games. This camera features a red color, a meniscus 25mm f11 lens, a shutter speed of 1/90 sec (1/40 sec with flash), and a flash distance of 5-16 ft. It is a pocket camera that uses 110 film type and has a flipflash socket for flash. Made in the United States, this camera is a collectible piece for photography enthusiasts and vintage camera collectors.
